subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should browser snapshots become compact and goal-shaped by default, and what explicit raw/full snapshot escape hatch should remain for users who need complete page content or refs?
rationale: Current code has multiple partial mitigation knobs, but choosing default model-facing browser semantics and compatibility boundaries is a product decision rather than a narrow bug patch.

options.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
options.body: Make omitted browser snapshot/read calls use compact goal-shaped output by default, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact action change reports.

options.title: Action Diffs First
options.body: Keep snapshot defaults unchanged for now but add post-action change reports to reduce repeated snapshots during multi-step flows.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Efficient Mode
options.body: Leave current defaults in place and document browser.snapshotDefaults.mode="efficient" plus raw maxChars controls as the supported mitigation.

recommendation.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
recommendation.body: Make omitted browser snapshot/read calls use compact goal-shaped output by default, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact action change reports.
